context_requirements: Constitutive activation of the RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK pathway (e.g., BRAF V600E, KRAS mutation, or upstream RTK activation) for strong transcriptional response
Wild-type or functional RB and TP53 for robust cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis programs
Active ERK signaling to allow feedback induction of DUSP/SPRY genes upon MEK inhibition
falsifiers: No decrease in proliferation or cell-cycle gene expression at 24 h in BRAF-mutant lines (e.g., A375, HT29)
No induction of immediate-early feedback genes (DUSP6, SPRY2, ETV1) at 6 h in any line
Strong transcriptional response in all nine lines regardless of RAS/RAF mutation status
No difference in response between BRAF-mutant and wild-type lines

evidence.supports: MEK inhibition stops cell proliferation and induces apoptosis in solid tumors
MEK inhibition blocks cell proliferation and induces apoptosis in melanoma, with BRAF mutation associated with response
MEK inhibitor GDC-0973 induces apoptosis biomarkers including Bcl-2 family proapoptotic regulators in BRAF and KRAS mutant cancer cells
MEK inhibition in B-RAF mutant tumor cells causes cell cycle arrest and upregulation of proapoptotic Bim

changes: Removed DUSP6, SPRED2, ETV1, FOSL1, EGR1, FOS, JUN from proximal_down: MEK inhibition relieves ERK-mediated negative feedback, so these immediate-early/feedback genes are induced, not repressed, at 6 h.
Removed CCND1 and MYC from proximal_up: these are ERK-driven proliferation genes and are repressed, not induced, by MEK inhibition; they remain in proximal_down.
Removed duplicate DUSP6, SPRED2, ETV1, FOSL1, EGR1, FOS, JUN from proximal_down so no gene appears in both up and down lists at the same time.
Kept late_down proliferation genes (CCNE2, E2F2, MCM3, PCNA, TOP2A, AURKA, AURKB, BIRC5, PLK1, UBE2C, CDC20) as generic proliferation_down effects rather than proximal MEK targets.
Kept late_up stress/apoptosis genes (CDKN1A, GADD45A/B, PMAIP1, TRIB3, DDIT4, SESN1, SFN) as generic downstream effects, not direct proximal targets.
Retained line_response as given: strong in BRAF-mutant A375, moderate in KRAS/RAF-mutant HT29/A549/HCC515, weak in non-RAS/RAF-driven or less MAPK-dependent lines (HA1E, HEPG2, MCF7, PC3, VCAP).
Retained kinetics 'sustained' and magnitude 6h moderate / 24h strong, consistent with early feedback induction followed by later cytostatic/apoptotic transcriptional programs.
Retained all four evidence citations; each abstract supports the stated claim about MEK inhibition, proliferation arrest, apoptosis, and Bim/Bcl-2 family involvement.
